subject: red-legged seriema
title: This Bird Kills Snakes Without Ever Biting Them

scenes.text: This bird kills snakes, and it never needs to bite them.
The red-legged seriema stands almost three feet tall and hunts on foot across South American grassland.
It eats lizards, rodents, even venomous coral snakes.
It grabs the prey in its beak and slams it into the ground or onto a rock, again and again.
That breaks the bones, so it can swallow the meal. Its second toe even carries a sharp, sickle-shaped claw.
And it screams so loud you can hear it kilometres away.

description:
The red-legged seriema of South America kills prey by slamming it into the ground or onto rocks to break the bones before eating it.
It eats lizards, rodents and even venomous coral snakes, has a sickle-like claw on its second toe, and its call carries for kilometres.

first_comment: Seriemas are thought to be the closest living relatives of the giant terror birds. Would you want one in your backyard?
